description: This file defines service functions for handling bank details, including validation, signing, and database persistence. It exposes functions to save and retrieve bank information for users.

methods.name: deriveBranchInfo(ifsc)
methods.description: Derives branch information (bank code and branch code) from the provided IFSC code.

methods.name: saveBankDetails({ userId, accountNumber, confirmAccountNumber, ifsc, fullNameForESign, agreeESign, reasonForChange, critical, reauthPassword })
methods.description: Validates and saves bank details, including optional electronic signature binding and re-authentication for critical changes. Performs database insert or update within a transaction.

methods.name: getBankDetails(userId)
methods.description: Retrieves stored bank details for a specific user.
